decisions.reason: The yogurt won the eathealthy Award, which signals results above aspiration in the firm's core dairy offer, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
As a home-page flagship product in a growing industry, its early results are uncertain, but the firm's organisational slack and strategic commitment favour carrying it rather than dropping it.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the established offer and uses existing organic milk supply and processes, so keeping it costs little and its performance likely meets aspiration.
This spicy cheese line has several models; individual variants may be pruned, but the line as a whole is likely kept while results remain uncertain and slack is available.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the new cheese range, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration, management would keep it for now.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a more niche item with some risk of weak sales, but nothing reported points to failure, so it is retained for another period.
